content: *God. If there is a god. Or gods. Or the souls of those I’ve wronged. My greed had driven me for many years. My sadism in inaction has lead to the deaths of many. My ignorance, my selfishness, and my lust for power and knowledge. I am that person no more. I am that greed-bound devil no more. I will not turn into my father, no matter how I vainly and naively idolized him. I will continue to lay down my life for those I love, however foolish, until you can recognize me. I am not joining this for you, or them, and I suppose that is selfish in itself, but I am joining this for me. For me to aspire to be something good in this world of noble wretches and wretched nobles. I submit myself to your judgement this second time. Do what you will.*

category: 🪑 week two player quarters
content: “The sword. It made me realize I was not true of heart. My actions were benevolent my my intentions were selfish. If I was to truly prove myself worthy, I had to put away my greatest flaw: greed. I’ll admit. I’m obsessed with knowledge and money and power and perfection. I can’t be happy without it and it drives me insane sometimes. I needed to prove, not only to the sword, but to *myself* that I was *good* enough. I have come far, but not nearly far enough. Cato, I do not deserve to be wedded to you if I am filled with greed and power and lust for knowledge that is guarded for reasons larger than me. I needed to prove to myself that I am worthy to be loved the way you love me, and that when I put my life on the line for others, that I’m not doing it for a name, or for a legacy. I love you. I will protect myself, but you come first and I may be headstrong and still learning, but I will put you and the friends I love first any time. I will put the lives of strangers before my own if that means I can atone for the sins of my past and be better in the present. I love you, my darling Cato, and I wish I could make you wholly understand but that will take time.”

content:
Navars tears echo of a pain hundreds of years old and deeper than even this point of the ocean. he will be the last one to leave the chamber, only following after about 10 minutes. 
"when it was done, and we carried the day, 
I watched her life's blood go slipping away. 
and I sat down, into her cold blue eyes-. 
sweet mother mary, deliver her grace. 
deliver us all, from the look on her face and the screams, the long and desperate sighs.

all our lives, have been a cruel secret.
all our lives. a tender ancient bloom.
so I drink this final cup.
and I rest this weary head.
and I watch the waters rising up
to wash away the dead.
and when we're rid of this disease
and we have won the prize.
I never will return to these, foreign skies."

he stands over the grave and places his sickle where he found the bracers. "I will come back for you. If I can't hear your voice today, I will press on for what you loved. I will have a garden waiting for you"
